'''Kyōko Itō''' (Japanese: '''伊藤 京子''' ''Itō Kyōko'') is an animator, illustrator, and character designer who has worked on the Pokémon series. She is one of the chief animation directors and the additional character designer for {{aniseries|HZ}}.

Itō began work on the series as an in-between animator under [[OLM, Inc.]] for {{aniseries|SM}}. By ''[[SM052|Revealing the Stuff of Legend!]]'', she had moved to a position as a 2nd key animator. On {{aniseries|JN}}, she worked as a key animator and eventually also animation director for several main episodes as well as for the ''[[Team Rocket Expedition which stands by the evils of love and truth]]'' [[bonus segment]]s.

She is credited as '''Ito Kyoko''' as an illustrator for the {{pkmn|Trading Card Game}}. She illustrates exclusively for cards related to the animated series. Her first card was {{TCG ID|SVP Promo|Fuecoco|192}}, one of the {{TCG|SVP Black Star Promos}}.
